state: I'm writing again about the washing machine I bought from you six weeks ago, and honestly I'm running out of patience. This is the third time a technician has come to my apartment and left without actually fixing anything. The first visit, the repair person said it just needed a new drain pump, but two weeks later it started leaking again. The second technician said the actual problem was the control board, ordered a part, and never followed up to schedule the install. When I called last Tuesday, the agent on the phone told me a specialist would call within 48 hours - that was eight days ago and nobody has called. Meanwhile I've spent close to two hundred dollars on laundromat visits because the machine still doesn't work. I've kept every case number from every call: 4471, 4502, 4589, and now this one. Every time I explain the whole history again from scratch because apparently none of it gets written down properly. I work full time and I've had to take three half-days off just to be home for appointments that didn't solve anything. At this point I don't want another promise that someone will 'look into it' - I want a real date when this will actually be fixed, or I want the machine replaced entirely. I've been about as patient as anyone could reasonably be for six weeks straight, but I'm getting close to just disputing the charge with my bank and buying a machine from a different company. Please have someone with actual authority call me, not another agent reading from a script.

This is my fourth message about the overage charges on my account this month, and I need someone to actually resolve it instead of forwarding me to another department. Every time I call, I get told a different story: first that the charges were a system error and would be reversed within 24 hours, then that no such reversal was ever logged, then that I needed to wait for a billing review that apparently takes 10 business days. It's now been three weeks. I've read out my account number, the incident numbers, and the dates of every call so many times I could recite them in my sleep. I switched to your network specifically because a friend said the customer service was reliable, and so far that has not been my experience at all. I'm not asking for anything unreasonable, just for the $86 in charges that were never supposed to be there in the first place to actually come off my bill, and for someone to confirm it in writing this time instead of a verbal promise I have no way to hold anyone to. I still want to stay with this carrier, but I need this handled by someone who can actually close the ticket instead of restarting it. Please don't tell me again that it's in progress unless you can also tell me when it will be done.

I noticed I was charged twice for my guest pass again this month, which makes the second time this has happened since I joined the downtown location. I get that twelve dollars isn't going to break anyone, but that's not really the point - it means nobody actually fixed it after I raised it the first time, and now I have to go through the whole thing again just to get a small refund. I'd appreciate it if someone actually looked at the account this time instead of just telling me it's resolved when it clearly isn't.

My order arrived almost an hour past the estimated time, and when it finally showed up, the fries were stone cold and the burger I paid extra for was clearly just a regular one swapped in. This is the second time in three orders that something's been wrong, and I don't think it's unreasonable to expect what I actually paid for. I'd like a refund for the difference, and honestly I'm starting to wonder if I should just order from somewhere else that gets it right the first time.

I am done waiting on hold for a TOASTER. Three separate calls, three separate people telling me my replacement is 'processing,' and it has been SEVENTEEN DAYS for a thirty-dollar appliance that takes five minutes to swap out of a warehouse. This is genuinely pathetic. Either someone ships the replacement today or I'm charging back the entire order and telling everyone I know to avoid this company. I am not calling a fourth time to get the same scripted non-answer.

Hi there! I wanted to check in about the blender I ordered last week - it arrived yesterday but unfortunately the pitcher lid doesn't seal properly, so it leaks a bit whenever I blend anything liquid. It's a little annoying since I was looking forward to using it for smoothies every morning, but it's not a huge deal, I've just been holding a towel under it in the meantime! I looked through the manual and it doesn't seem to be something I can fix myself, so I think it might just need a replacement part or a new unit altogether. No rush on my end at all - I know you're probably dealing with a lot of requests, and I'd rather you take the time to sort it properly than rush something out that has the same issue. If it's easier, I'm happy to send a photo of the lid so your team can see exactly what's going on. I've ordered from you a few times before and everything else has always worked out fine, so I'm not worried this will be any different. Whenever you get a chance, just let me know what the next step is - whether that's a replacement lid, a whole new blender, or something else you'd recommend. Thanks so much for your help, and I hope you're having a good week otherwise! Also, if there's a warranty registration I should fill out for the replacement, just point me to it and I'll take care of that on my end too.

Someone at your company charged my card $412 for a plan I cancelled two months ago, and this is the third time I've had to deal with unauthorized charges from you people. I already disputed this once and was told it was 'fixed.' It was not fixed. I'm done being polite about this - if this charge isn't reversed by tomorrow, I'm reporting this as fraud to my bank, filing a complaint with the state attorney general's office, and posting the entire email chain publicly so other people know what they're dealing with. Do not send me another form response telling me to 'allow 5-7 business days.'

This is the fourth time I've called about the data overage charge that was never supposed to happen, and I'm really losing patience with this. Every representative tells me something different, nobody follows up like they promise, and I still haven't gotten a straight answer about when it'll actually be fixed. I've been a customer for six years and I don't think it's too much to ask for this to just get resolved instead of restarted every single time I call.

My internet's been dropping out for a few minutes every couple of hours since yesterday evening - not constant, just often enough that it trips me up mid-task sometimes. I restarted the router twice already, which helped for a bit but it started again this morning. No huge rush, but whenever someone has a minute, could you take a look at whether there's an outage on your end in my area? Happy to try anything else in the meantime too.
Cancel my membership immediately, remove my card from your system entirely, and expect to hear from my attorney about the three charges you were told twice to stop making.

This is my second message about flight 482 being delayed for the third time today with zero real explanation - first it was weather, then a crew issue, now nothing on the board at all. I've already missed the connection I paid extra to protect, and the app still won't let me rebook without holding for over an hour. I've tried being reasonable about this all afternoon, but I really need someone to actually get on the phone and sort out a new itinerary, not another push notification telling me to 'check back later.'

I noticed the locker room key fobs at the north location have stopped working twice this week, so I've had to ask the front desk to let me in with my things instead of just tapping like usual. It's a small thing and everyone there has been nice about sorting me out both times, but I figured it's worth flagging in case other members are running into the same thing. Whenever your maintenance team gets a chance to look at the reader, that'd be great - definitely not urgent on my end.
For the third time this month my order's arrived missing the drink I paid for - I'm about ready to just stop ordering from you if this keeps happening.
The space heater I bought two weeks ago already stopped turning on, and honestly for something marketed as heavy-duty I expected it to at least make it through one cold snap before dying on me.

Just wanted to flag that my account shows a $340 charge from a phone number I don't recognize, on a device I don't own, billed to my plan last night. I imagine this might be some kind of mix-up on the account or possibly identity theft, so whenever your fraud team has a chance, could they take a look and let me know what they find? No particular timeline needed, just wanted it on your radar so it doesn't get overlooked.

I've now been rerouted twice through two different cities to get to a wedding that starts in five hours, and each gate agent has given me a different reason for why the original flight got cancelled. I get that things happen, but this is the third disruption this trip alone, and I don't have much give left in how I'm handling it today. If there's any seat on anything leaving in the next two hours, I need it - I really can't afford another delay today.

Hi! Just wanted to let you know that when my order showed up tonight, the small fries I added were missing from the bag - everything else was there and correct, just not those. It's a bit of a bummer since I was looking forward to them, but it's really not a big deal in the scheme of things, these things happen sometimes when a kitchen is busy! I don't need a full refund or anything dramatic, maybe just a credit for the fries themselves would be more than enough if that's something you're able to do. I've ordered from this location probably a dozen times now and this is honestly the first time anything's been missing, so I'm not too worried about it being a pattern. The delivery driver was really friendly and got everything here quickly despite what looked like a pretty busy Friday night, so no complaints there at all. If it's easier for your team, I'm also totally fine just letting this one go - I mainly wanted to mention it in case it helps you catch a packing issue on busier nights. Either way, thanks for reading through this, and I hope the rest of your evening goes smoothly! Let me know if you need my order number to look into the credit, happy to send it over whenever works for you.

I switched to the new unlimited plan last week and noticed my data speed drops noticeably after around 30GB of use, which I hadn't seen mentioned anywhere when I signed up. It hasn't really messed up anything I do day to day, streaming still works fine even if it takes a second longer to load, but I was curious whether that's expected or if something on my end might be off. Either way, no complaints about the switch overall - just wanted to check.

This is the sixth hour my internet has been down today, the third day this month this has happened, and your automated line keeps hanging up on me after the same useless troubleshooting script. I work from home and I've now missed two client calls because of this. I want a technician at my house tomorrow morning or I want this account cancelled and every dollar I've paid this month refunded - and if I have to call a seventh time to get either of those things, I'm taking this to every review site I can find.

Oh no worries, I only ordered this three-tier birthday cake for a party that's already over, so it showing up a day late is basically perfect timing! Kidding aside, it's a bit of a bummer but I know deliveries get backed up sometimes, so I'm not going to lose sleep over cake - if there's a partial credit for next time that would be nice, but if not, no big deal either way. Thanks for even getting it here at all!

My package was supposed to arrive three days ago and the tracking still just says 'in transit' with no updates since then. I've already rearranged my schedule twice to be home for it, and it's honestly frustrating to keep waiting without any real information. Could someone actually check where it is and give me a straight answer instead of the generic tracking page?

Oh fantastic, the internet's down again - what a wonderful surprise for the fourth time this month, right as I'm on a call that could've saved my job. Truly, bravo to whoever keeps 'fixing' this, because it clearly works great. At this point I'd love nothing more than to keep paying you every month for a service that doesn't function, so please, do take your time getting back to me - I'll just be here explaining to my boss why I keep dropping off calls. Actually, no - fix this today or cancel my account, because I am done.

I wanted to flag something on my last statement - there's a charge for $1,240 that I don't recognize, listed as a 'premium service upgrade' from two weeks ago. I definitely didn't sign up for anything like that, and it's obviously a fairly large amount, so I did a bit of a double take when I saw it! That said, I'm sure this kind of thing happens sometimes, maybe a box got checked during a call I didn't fully catch, or it's a system mix-up on your end - either is totally possible. I've attached a screenshot of the line item so your billing team can see exactly what I'm referring to without me having to describe it in circles. I'm not in any kind of rush on this; I know these things can take a little while to research properly, especially if it involves pulling up an old call recording or checking with a different department. If it turns out I did agree to something and just don't remember the details, that's completely fine too - I'd just like to understand what it's for either way. In the meantime, I'll keep an eye on the account and let you know if anything else looks off, but this is really the only thing that's caught my attention so far. Thanks in advance for looking into it, and there's no need to rush a callback - an email update whenever someone has a chance to check would work perfectly well for me.

Hi there, I'd like to add an international roaming pack to my plan before I travel to Portugal next month. Could you let me know which options are available, what they cost, and how they'd apply against my current plan's data allowance? Happy to provide my account number if that's helpful for pulling up the details. Thanks so much for the help!

I've looked at my statement three times now and I'm still being billed for the equipment protection add-on I cancelled back in March. This is the second billing cycle it's shown up on despite the email confirming it was removed. I'd like this actually taken off for good this time and the two months refunded, because I shouldn't have to keep tracking this myself.

My connecting flight got pushed back forty minutes, so I'll have a shorter layover than planned, but the app says I should still make it comfortably. Just wanted to double check there's nothing else I need to do on my end.

I worked from the kitchen table again this morning because the connection kept cutting out every time I tried to join a video call from my desk, the same thing that happened yesterday afternoon. I ended up finishing a presentation from my phone's hotspot instead, watching the data meter climb the whole time, because waiting around for the connection to stabilize wasn't really an option with a deadline sitting there. My partner ran into the same issue trying to submit coursework last night, so it doesn't seem to be just one device or one room in the house. I checked the router lights and everything looks normal - no red lights, no error messages, just a connection that comes and goes without any pattern I can figure out. I restarted the router, unplugged it for a minute, and even moved it to a different outlet, and none of that made a real difference for more than an hour. I've started keeping a written log of exactly when it drops, mostly because I'm hoping that might help whoever looks into this figure out what's actually going on, since guessing hasn't gotten anywhere. It would be useful to have someone actually check the line itself rather than walk me through another reset, since I've already tried the things a reset is supposed to fix. Working from the kitchen table with a phone propped against a mug isn't exactly how I pictured today going, and I'd rather not have tomorrow look the same way.

I'm reaching out again about the internet outage that's now stretched into its third full day, and at this point I've basically lost patience with the whole process. The first time I called, I was told a technician would be dispatched within 24 hours - nobody showed up and nobody called to explain why. The second time, I was told the outage was a 'known issue in the area' that would resolve itself, but three of my neighbors on this same street have working internet from your service right now, so that clearly isn't true either. I work from home and I've had to reschedule two client meetings and explain to my manager why I keep missing video calls, which is not a conversation I want to keep having. I've now spent something like six hours total on hold across four different calls, repeating the same account details every single time because apparently nothing gets saved in your system between calls. I don't think I'm asking for anything unusual - I just want a technician on site, a real appointment window, and someone to actually follow through on it instead of another vague promise. At this point I'm seriously considering switching providers entirely, because three days without service and four unhelpful phone calls is more than enough for me to lose confidence that this is going to get fixed properly. Please escalate this to someone who can actually schedule a technician today, not someone reading from the same script I've already heard three times this week.
I've called about this same billing error four times now and nobody has fixed it. Reverse the charge today or I'm cancelling everything and disputing every payment I've ever made to you.
This is UNACCEPTABLE - my package has been 'out for delivery' for six days straight with no explanation. Refund me NOW or I'm done ordering from this company for good.

My delivery is tracking about a day behind the original estimate, which I saw happens sometimes around the holidays. No action needed on my end - I just wanted to check whether the new estimated date is likely to hold, since I'll plan to be home either way. Thanks for the update either way!

This is the third delay announced for this flight in the last two hours, and every single explanation has been different from the last one. I've already missed my hotel check-in window and now I'm being told there might not be a crew available at all tonight. I want a supervisor at this gate in the next ten minutes, and if I'm rebooked on a flight tomorrow without a hotel voucher and meal credit, I will be filing a formal complaint with the aviation authority the second I land.

Hello, I'm reaching out about a charge on my account from last week that I don't recognize - it's listed as $58.20 under a merchant code I'm not familiar with, dated the 14th. I've gone through my recent purchases and can't match it to anything I bought, so I wanted to check whether it might be related to a subscription renewal, a partner service bundled with my plan, or possibly something that needs a closer look on your end. I'm not too worried about it either way; these things usually turn out to have a simple explanation, whether that's a delayed charge from something I forgot about or a processing quirk on your side. If it does turn out to be something that needs correcting, that's completely fine, there's no rush at all - whenever your billing team has a chance to look into it works for me. I mostly just wanted to get this on record in case it's useful to flag early rather than waiting until it happens again, if it's actually a pattern rather than a one-off. Please let me know if you need any additional information from me, like a screenshot of the statement or the exact reference number listed next to the charge - happy to send whatever would help move things along. Thanks very much for taking a look, and have a great rest of your week.

The ice maker on the fridge I bought last month seems to only make about half the amount of ice the manual says it should, though everything else about the unit is working exactly as expected. I looked through the settings and don't see anything obviously misconfigured, so I thought I'd check whether that's just normal for this model or if there's a setting I might be missing. Not a big deal if it's expected behavior - just curious either way.

I ordered a set of patio chairs about two weeks ago, and the tracking page has shown 'processing' the whole time without moving to a shipped status yet. I know furniture items sometimes ship separately or take longer to leave the warehouse compared to smaller items, so I wasn't necessarily expecting it right away, but I figured it was worth checking in since it's been a little while since the order was placed. If there's a more specific timeline your system can pull up, that would be helpful, just so I know roughly when to expect it and can plan around it if needed. I don't have anything time-sensitive tied to this order, so there's genuinely no rush from my side - I'm mostly just trying to get a sense of whether this is normal for this category of item or whether something might have gotten stuck somewhere in the process. If it's easier for your team, I'm also fine waiting for the next scheduled status update instead of a special check, whatever's simplest on your end. I've ordered a few smaller things from you before without any issues, so I have no reason to think this one's any different, just wanted to ask since it's been quiet on the tracking page for a while now. Thanks for taking a look whenever you get the chance, and no worries at all if it just needs a bit more time to update.

My internet dropped for about ten minutes around 3pm today but came back on its own before I even had a chance to restart the router. Just wanted to mention it in case it's useful for your monitoring.
My flight this afternoon is showing a 25 minute delay on the app. Just confirming that's accurate before I head to the airport - no other questions on my end.

I've emailed about the billing issue on my membership three separate times now, and I keep getting the same auto-reply saying someone will follow up within 48 hours, which has now stretched into almost three weeks with zero actual response from a person. The problem itself isn't even complicated - I was charged for the annual plan when I specifically selected monthly at sign-up, and I have the confirmation email showing exactly that, which I've now attached three separate times to three separate threads. Each time I follow up, I have to start over because whoever picks up the new email clearly hasn't read the previous ones, judging by the questions they ask me. I've tried calling twice as well, and both times I was on hold for over 40 minutes before getting disconnected without ever reaching anyone. At this point I've paid for four months of a membership tier I never agreed to, and I'm genuinely running out of ways to explain this that would get someone to actually look at the attached proof instead of asking me to describe the problem again from scratch. I'd like the difference refunded and the plan corrected to monthly going forward, and I'd really appreciate if this could be handled by one person who reads the whole thread instead of getting reset every time. If I don't hear something concrete this week, I'm going to have to dispute the charges directly with my card issuer, which I'd honestly rather not do if this can just get fixed the normal way.

Oh, I just love finding a surprise $95 'service fee' on my statement for the third month running - really keeps things exciting! I'm sure there's a perfectly good explanation, the same way there was the last two times someone told me it was 'already removed' and then it showed up again anyway. I'd be ever so grateful if someone could actually take it off for good this time, rather than telling me it's handled and having me discover otherwise next month like clockwork.
Wonderful, my 'unlimited' plan throttled me down to dial-up speeds again halfway through the month. Would be great if that word actually meant something on my bill.
Quick question - does the veggie wrap on your lunch menu contain nuts? Just checking before I place an order, thanks!
Tracking still shows my order stuck at the same distribution hub as it was four days ago, past the date I was given, and that's cutting it close for the birthday it was supposed to arrive before.

This is the third replacement part your team has sent for the same dishwasher in six weeks, and I've now used up every vacation day I had left waiting home for technicians who keep showing up without the right tools.
My flight has been delayed twice already today and nobody at the gate can tell me anything useful - it's honestly pretty frustrating trying to plan around updates that keep changing.

Well, clearly the sauna being 'temporarily closed for maintenance' for the fourth month running means you're secretly building me a private spa back there, right? Ha - genuinely don't mean that as a complaint, I actually don't even use the sauna myself, someone else mentioned it to me in the locker room and I got curious. Mostly reaching out today about something else entirely: I wanted to ask whether the new class schedule that starts next month includes any early Saturday options, since the current lineup is mostly weekday evenings and I'm trying to rearrange my routine around a new work schedule. If there's a cycling or strength class anywhere before 9am on weekends, that would fit really well for me, but if not, no worries at all, I can probably make the weekday slots work with a bit of shuffling. Also, completely separate question - is there a way to freeze my membership for a couple of weeks in November while I'm traveling, or does that need to go through a specific form? I remember doing something similar last year but I don't remember exactly how I set it up. Take your time getting back to me on any of this, none of it is time-sensitive, I just wanted to get a few questions out in one message instead of sending three separate ones. Thanks so much, and enjoy the rest of your week - tell the front desk team they're doing a great job, the place has felt really well run lately.

My connection has dropped three separate times during work calls this week, and each time I have to scramble to rejoin from my phone while everyone waits. I checked and it's not a device issue since it happens on every device in the house. I'd like someone to actually look into what's causing it rather than just telling me to restart the router again, since I've already done that more times than I can count.
The scale in the locker room has been out of order for about a week now. Not a big deal for me personally, just wanted to mention it in case it's on someone's list already.

I am absolutely done with this. You charged me TWICE for the same order and when I called to fix it, the rep hung up on me mid-sentence. This is theft, plain and simple, and if I don't see both charges reversed by end of day, I'm reporting this to my bank as fraud and never using this company again.

I ordered a large pepperoni pizza and got a small cheese one instead, which is frustrating because I specifically paid extra for the large size and the toppings I wanted. This is the second mix-up from this location in the past month, and I'd like either a correction or a refund - it shouldn't be this hard to get the right order.

I ordered dinner for my daughter's birthday party two hours ago and it still hasn't arrived, even though the app has said '5 minutes away' for the last forty minutes straight. I've called the restaurant three times and nobody picks up, and your chat support keeps disconnecting me the moment I finish explaining the situation, like clockwork, every single time. There are eight kids here who were promised pizza an hour and a half ago, and I have had to scramble to order from somewhere else entirely just to feed them, which means I'm now paying for two orders instead of one. I don't want a coupon, I don't want 'points,' and I definitely don't want to hear that this is being 'escalated' by someone who then disappears the second the chat window closes. I want the full amount refunded today, and I want written confirmation that it's been processed, not a promise that it's 'in progress' somewhere in a queue I can't see. If I don't get a real response in the next hour, I'm disputing the charge with my bank, leaving a detailed review on every platform I can find, and making sure everyone in my family's group chat knows not to bother ordering from you for something that actually matters. This isn't some minor mix-up - you ruined part of my kid's birthday, and the least you can do is not waste any more of my time pretending to fix it.

My connecting flight's gate changed twice in the last hour, so I've had to walk a bit further than expected, but the new boarding time still gives me plenty of buffer. Just wanted to confirm I have the right gate now.

I have had it with this gym completely. This is the SIXTH time I've been charged for a personal training package I cancelled back in June, and every single time I call, someone tells me it's 'been removed' and then it shows up again the very next month like nothing happened. I have the cancellation confirmation email sitting right in front of me with a date, a confirmation number, and a name, and somehow that still isn't enough for anyone there to actually fix this. I have wasted literal hours of my life on hold, repeating the same story to person after person who clearly cannot do anything except apologize and transfer me to someone else who also cannot do anything. At this point I don't believe a single word anyone from this company tells me, because I've been told it's fixed at least four times now and it has never once actually been fixed. I want every single one of these charges refunded immediately, I want my membership cancelled effective today, and I want it in writing, because clearly a phone call means absolutely nothing here. If this isn't resolved by tomorrow, I am disputing every charge with my bank, reporting this company to consumer protection, and telling every single person I know who mentioned joining this gym to run in the other direction. I have never in my life dealt with a company this incompetent, and at this point I'm not even asking nicely anymore.

The espresso machine's steam wand seems to need a firmer twist than the manual describes to lock into place - works fine once it's seated, just noting it in case that's useful for the next version of the manual.

This is the second time this week a package has shown as delivered when nothing was actually left at my door, and both times I've had to file a claim and wait days for any response. I've got security footage proving nothing was dropped off either time, which I've already sent twice now. I really need this resolved without having to explain the whole thing a third time, because at this point I'm not sure what else I can do to prove packages aren't showing up.

Hi! I noticed a small charge on my statement this month for $4.99 labeled as a 'service fee' that I don't remember seeing on previous statements. It's not a huge amount by any means, so I'm not too worried about it, but I figured it was worth asking about since I couldn't immediately place what it was for. I looked back through my recent settings changes and emails and didn't see anything obvious that would explain a new fee being added, so I thought I'd just check with you all directly rather than guess. If it turns out to be something new that got added to my plan, that's completely fine, I just want to understand what it covers so I know what I'm paying for going forward. And if it's some kind of billing error, no worries at all either, these things happen and I'm sure it's a quick fix on your end. Either way, there's genuinely no rush on my part, I mostly just wanted to flag it while it was fresh in my mind rather than let it slip and forget to ask next month. Feel free to just reply whenever you get a chance, and let me know if you need my account number or the exact date of the charge to look into it - happy to send over whatever's useful. Thanks so much for your help, and hope you're having a good week!

Hi, quick question about my plan - I upgraded to the 15GB tier last week but I'm still seeing throttled speeds once I hit around 8GB, which is a bit annoying since that's half of what I'm supposedly paying for now. Not a huge deal, I can work around it for now, just wanted to flag it in case something didn't switch over properly on your end. Would appreciate a check whenever someone has a minute!
Kind of annoying that my new plan still shows the old data cap in the app even though support confirmed the upgrade went through - could someone take a look when you get a chance?

A bit frustrating that my package has been sitting at 'out for delivery' since yesterday morning with no update since, but I know these things happen - just wanted to check if there's an actual estimate.
Bit of a bummer that half my order showed up missing the dipping sauces I paid extra for, but everything else arrived fine - any chance you could just credit those back?

So I switched my billing date like you suggested, and it mostly worked, except now my autopay ran a day early and overlapped with another payment, which was a little annoying to sort out with my bank. Nothing major, I got it fixed on my end, I just wanted to mention it in case the date change is causing the same hiccup for other people too. Thanks for your help earlier, by the way - that part went smoothly!

My flight's been pushed back forty minutes so far, which is a little annoying since I've got a tight connection on the other end, but the gate agent says there's still a decent buffer if nothing else changes. Not trying to get worked up over it yet, just wanted to ask if you're seeing anything on your end that might affect my connecting flight specifically. Thanks for keeping an eye on it!
Kind of annoying that the departure board still says 'on time' when the gate agent already told us it's running about thirty minutes late - any chance the app could just get updated to match?

My delivery window came and went yesterday without the package showing up, and it's still just sitting at the same status this morning, which is mildly frustrating since I took the afternoon off to be home for it. I'm sure it'll turn up, I just wanted to see if you have any more specific timing than what the tracking page shows. Appreciate you looking into it whenever you can!

My delivery was marked as complete yesterday but nothing was actually left at my door, and now I'm out the cost of the order with no idea how to resolve it. This isn't good enough for something I paid for in advance.

I'm pretty unhappy that my package arrived three days past the delivery window with zero explanation or update the entire time. At the very least I'd expect some kind of notice when something's running that late.
